methodology: Verified 2026/27 Bundesliga membership against the official DFL fixture list.
Applied a current-squad gate before considering penalty evidence; rumours alone did not remove a player and no departed player was retained.
Prioritised direct same-match on-pitch precedence, then 2026 preseason and 2025/26 competitive regular-time penalties.
Used official club and Bundesliga/DFL sources first, then Kicker, LigaInsider and credible German or local reporting.
Used career penalty records only as fallback evidence where no current-club hierarchy event existed.
Excluded shootouts from regular-time hierarchy evidence and labelled any shootout-only evidence explicitly.

clubs.rationale: Rieder converted two 2025/26 league penalties and took the October penalty after Claude-Maurice had entered at half-time, giving direct on-pitch precedence. Claude-Maurice remains the most credible deputy despite his April miss. Gregoritsch converted at Wolfsburg when Rieder was no longer available for the kick.
clubs.uncertainty_note: No 2026/27 competitive penalty has confirmed whether Rieder retains the role. The secondary and tertiary order has no direct same-match test.
transfer_conditions: If Alexis Claude-Maurice completes a transfer, Michael Gregoritsch moves to secondary pending a new signing or preseason penalty event.
